description: Run YouTube channel operations from content planning through publishing to performance analysis.

steps.description: Plan the YouTube content calendar: topics, formats, and upload schedule.

inputs.name: channel-niche
inputs.desc: The channel's topic area and target audience

inputs.name: upload-frequency
inputs.desc: How often videos will be published (weekly, biweekly, etc.)

outputs.name: content-calendar
outputs.desc: Scheduled list of video topics, formats, and publish dates

outputs.name: content-pillars
outputs.desc: The recurring content categories the channel will cover

process: Review the channel niche and audience interests to identify high-demand topics.
Define 3 to 5 content pillars that the channel will rotate through.
Map topics to the upload schedule for the planning period.
Flag seasonal or time-sensitive topics that need specific publish dates.

steps.description: Manage the production of a single YouTube video from script to final edit.

inputs.name: content-calendar
inputs.desc: The planned video topic and format

inputs.name: content-pillars
inputs.desc: The content category this video falls under

outputs.name: video-file
outputs.desc: The finished video file ready for upload

outputs.name: thumbnail-file
outputs.desc: The thumbnail image designed for the video

process: Write the video script or outline based on the scheduled topic.
Shoot or record the footage according to the script.
Edit the video (cuts, transitions, graphics, audio mixing).
Design the thumbnail with a clear focal point and readable text.

steps.description: Optimize the video metadata for search and discovery.

inputs.name: content-pillars
inputs.desc: The content category for keyword context

outputs.name: optimized-metadata
outputs.desc: Title, description, tags, and end screen configuration

outputs.name: seo-keywords
outputs.desc: The target keywords and their search volume estimates

process: Research keywords related to the video topic using search suggest and analytics.
Write the title with the primary keyword placed early.
Write the description with keywords, timestamps, and links.
Select tags and configure end screens and cards.

steps.description: Publish the video and run the initial promotion.

inputs.name: optimized-metadata
inputs.desc: The title, description, tags, and configuration

outputs.name: publish-record
outputs.desc: The published video URL and publish timestamp

outputs.name: promotion-actions
outputs.desc: List of promotion activities completed (social posts, community tab, email)

process: Upload the video with the optimized metadata and thumbnail.
Schedule or publish at the optimal time based on audience activity.
Post promotion to social media, community tab, and email list.
Respond to early comments to boost engagement signals.

steps.description: Analyze video and channel performance metrics.

outputs.name: performance-report
outputs.desc: Metrics report (views, CTR, retention, subscribers gained, revenue)

outputs.name: channel-ops-plan
outputs.desc: Updated operations plan with lessons applied

process: Pull analytics after the initial performance window (48 hours, 7 days, 28 days).
Evaluate click-through rate, average view duration, and retention curve.
Compare against channel benchmarks and prior videos.
Document what worked and what to adjust for the next video.

description: Book and manage podcast guests from sourcing through episode publication.

steps.description: Define the ideal guest profile and source potential guests.

inputs.name: podcast-topic-focus
inputs.desc: The podcast's subject area and audience

inputs.name: episode-goals
inputs.desc: What the next batch of episodes should cover

outputs.name: guest-criteria
outputs.desc: The ideal guest profile (expertise, audience, availability)

outputs.name: prospect-list
outputs.desc: Ranked list of potential guests with contact information

process: Define what makes an ideal guest for the podcast (expertise, story, audience overlap).
Source prospects from industry events, social media, other podcasts, and referrals.
Rank prospects by fit, audience size, and likelihood of accepting.
Compile contact details and notes for outreach.

steps.description: Pitch, schedule, and confirm the guest for recording.

inputs.name: guest-criteria
inputs.desc: What the ideal guest looks like

inputs.name: prospect-list
inputs.desc: The ranked list of potential guests

outputs.name: confirmed-guest
outputs.desc: The booked guest with confirmed date and time

outputs.name: booking-details
outputs.desc: Recording platform, time zone, and technical requirements

process: Send personalized outreach to the top prospects explaining the podcast and why they fit.
Negotiate a recording date and time that works for both parties.
Send the calendar invite with the recording link and technical instructions.
Confirm 48 hours before the recording.

steps.description: Send pre-interview preparation materials to the guest.

outputs.name: prep-package
outputs.desc: The preparation materials sent to the guest (topics, questions, format)

outputs.name: interview-outline
outputs.desc: The interview outline for the host

process: Research the guest's background, recent work, and talking points.
Draft the interview questions and topic flow.
Send the guest a prep document with the topics, format, and any requests (bio, headshot, links).
Finalize the host's interview outline with follow-up questions.

steps.description: Conduct the podcast interview and capture the recording.

outputs.name: raw-recording
outputs.desc: The raw audio or video recording file

outputs.name: interview-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on key moments, timestamps, and highlights

process: Test the recording setup before the guest joins.
Conduct the interview following the outline while allowing natural conversation.
Note timestamps of key moments, quotable lines, and highlights.
Thank the guest and confirm next steps (review, publish date, promotion).

steps.description: Edit, publish, and promote the guest episode with co-promotion assets.

inputs.name: interview-notes
inputs.desc: Timestamps and highlights from the interview

outputs.name: published-episode
outputs.desc: The published episode URL and show notes

outputs.name: guest-pipeline-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the guest booking, interview, and episode

process: Edit the recording (trim, level audio, add intro/outro, remove filler).
Write show notes with timestamps, guest bio, and links.
Create promotional assets (audiogram clips, quote graphics) for the guest to share.
Publish the episode and notify the guest with the promotion assets.

description: Build a creator monetization strategy by auditing revenue streams and identifying new opportunities.

steps.description: Audit the current revenue streams and their performance.

inputs.name: creator-profile
inputs.desc: The creator's platforms, audience size, and content type

inputs.name: current-revenue-data
inputs.desc: Revenue figures by stream for the past 6 to 12 months

outputs.name: revenue-audit
outputs.desc: Breakdown of revenue by stream with trends and margins

outputs.name: audience-monetization-rate
outputs.desc: Revenue per subscriber or follower across streams

process: List every active revenue stream (ad revenue, sponsorships, merch, subscriptions, tips, courses, affiliates).
Pull revenue data for each stream over the analysis period.
Calculate the revenue share, growth trend, and margin for each stream.
Calculate the overall revenue per subscriber or follower.

steps.description: Identify new monetization opportunities based on the creator's audience and content.

inputs.name: audience-monetization-rate
inputs.desc: How well the audience is currently monetized

outputs.name: opportunity-list
outputs.desc: Ranked list of new monetization opportunities with estimated revenue potential

outputs.name: gap-analysis
outputs.desc: Which monetization methods peers use that this creator does not

process: Research what monetization methods similar creators in the niche use.
Identify gaps where the creator is undermonetized compared to peers.
Estimate the revenue potential for each opportunity based on audience size and engagement.
Rank opportunities by potential revenue, effort to implement, and brand fit.

steps.description: Model the revenue potential of the top monetization opportunities.

inputs.name: creator-profile
inputs.desc: The creator's platforms and audience data

outputs.name: revenue-model
outputs.desc: Projected revenue by stream for the next 12 months

outputs.name: implementation-priority
outputs.desc: Ordered list of which streams to launch first

process: For each opportunity, model the revenue based on conversion rates and pricing.
Factor in the time and cost to set up each stream.
Project the total revenue mix over 12 months with the new streams added.
Prioritize by the ratio of projected revenue to setup effort.

steps.description: Implement the prioritized monetization streams and track performance.

outputs.name: implementation-status
outputs.desc: Status of each new stream (launched, in progress, planned)

outputs.name: monetization-strategy-doc
outputs.desc: The complete monetization strategy document with actuals versus projections

process: Set up the infrastructure for each new stream (platform, payment, content).
Launch each stream according to the priority order.
Track actual revenue against projections monthly.
Adjust the strategy based on what is performing above or below model.

description: Manage a brand sponsorship deal from inquiry through performance reporting.

steps.description: Evaluate a sponsorship inquiry for brand fit and deal viability.

inputs.name: creator-brand-guidelines
inputs.desc: The creator's brand values and audience demographics

outputs.name: fit-assessment
outputs.desc: Whether the brand aligns with the creator's audience and values

outputs.name: deal-parameters
outputs.desc: The proposed deliverables, timeline, and budget range

process: Review the brand's product, reputation, and target demographic.
Compare the brand's audience with the creator's audience for overlap.
Assess whether the product is something the creator would genuinely use or recommend.
Outline the proposed deliverables and timeline from the inquiry.

steps.description: Negotiate the sponsorship terms and finalize the agreement.

inputs.name: fit-assessment
inputs.desc: Whether the brand is a good fit

outputs.name: signed-agreement
outputs.desc: The finalized sponsorship agreement with all terms

outputs.name: deliverable-schedule
outputs.desc: Timeline for content creation, approval, and publication

process: Set the rate based on the creator's audience size, engagement, and deliverable type.
Negotiate the deliverables (format, placement, frequency, exclusivity, usage rights).
Agree on the payment terms (upfront, on publish, net 30).
Finalize and sign the agreement.

steps.description: Produce the sponsored content and submit for brand approval.

outputs.name: approved-content
outputs.desc: The brand-approved sponsored content ready for publication

outputs.name: revision-log
outputs.desc: Record of any revision requests and how they were resolved

process: Create the sponsored content according to the agreement (video segment, post, story, etc.).
Submit for brand review by the agreed deadline.
Incorporate feedback within the scope of the agreement.
Get final approval and prepare for publication.

steps.description: Publish the sponsored content and report performance to the brand.

outputs.name: performance-report
outputs.desc: Metrics report (views, clicks, conversions, engagement) for the brand

outputs.name: sponsorship-deal-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the deal from inquiry to performance

process: Publish the content at the scheduled time with proper disclosure (ad, sponsored, partnership).
Track performance metrics over the reporting period.
Compile the performance report for the brand.
Send the report and invoice, and document the deal for future reference.

description: Distribute content across multiple platforms with format adaptation and cross-promotion.

steps.description: Define the platform strategy: which platforms to use and how each one fits the content.

inputs.name: content-type
inputs.desc: The type of content being distributed (video, audio, text, image)

inputs.name: target-audience
inputs.desc: Who the content is for and where they spend time online

outputs.name: platform-plan
outputs.desc: Which platforms to use and the role each one plays

outputs.name: format-requirements
outputs.desc: The format specs for each platform (dimensions, length, captions, hashtags)

process: List the candidate platforms (YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, newsletter, blog, podcast).
For each platform, define its role (primary, repurpose, promotion, community).
Document the format requirements for each (aspect ratio, max length, caption limits).
Prioritize platforms by where the target audience is most active.

steps.description: Adapt the source content for each target platform.

outputs.name: adapted-content-set
outputs.desc: The content adapted for each platform (files, captions, hashtags)

outputs.name: adaptation-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on what was changed for each platform and why

process: Take the source content and create derivatives for each platform.
Adjust the format (crop, resize, trim, add captions or subtitles).
Write platform-specific captions and select hashtags.
Review each adaptation against the platform's best practices.

steps.description: Schedule the adapted content across all platforms.

inputs.name: adapted-content-set
inputs.desc: The content ready for each platform

inputs.name: platform-plan
inputs.desc: The posting strategy for each platform

outputs.name: publish-schedule
outputs.desc: The scheduled post times for each platform

outputs.name: cross-promo-plan
outputs.desc: How each platform will reference the others to drive traffic

process: Determine the optimal posting time for each platform based on audience activity.
Stagger the posts so the primary platform publishes first.
Add cross-promotion elements (links, mentions, CTAs pointing to other platforms).
Load the content into the scheduling tool or publish queue.

steps.description: Track performance across all platforms and produce the distribution report.

inputs.name: publish-schedule
inputs.desc: What was posted where and when

outputs.name: platform-performance
outputs.desc: Metrics by platform (reach, engagement, clicks, followers gained)

outputs.name: distribution-report
outputs.desc: Aggregate report comparing platform performance and cross-promo effectiveness

process: Pull analytics from each platform after the reporting window.
Compare reach, engagement rate, and traffic driven across platforms.
Evaluate which cross-promotion tactics generated the most referral traffic.
Document findings and recommendations for the next distribution cycle.

description: Grow the audience for a creator or brand by identifying growth levers and running experiments.

steps.description: Analyze the current audience: demographics, engagement, and growth rate.

inputs.name: analysis-period
inputs.desc: The time range to analyze (e.g., last 90 days)

outputs.name: audience-profile
outputs.desc: Demographics, interests, and behavior patterns of the current audience

outputs.name: growth-baseline
outputs.desc: Current growth rate, engagement rate, and retention metrics

process: Pull audience demographics from each platform's analytics.
Calculate the growth rate (new followers per period) and churn rate.
Identify the top sources of new followers (search, recommendations, referrals, paid).
Establish the baseline metrics to measure growth experiments against.

steps.description: Identify the available growth levers and prioritize them.

outputs.name: growth-levers
outputs.desc: Prioritized list of growth tactics (SEO, collabs, paid, community, cross-platform)

outputs.name: experiment-plan
outputs.desc: The plan for testing each growth lever

process: List the available growth levers: SEO, collaborations, paid promotion, community engagement, cross-platform posting, email list building.
For each lever, estimate the potential impact based on the audience profile and baseline.
Prioritize by expected impact relative to effort and cost.
Design an experiment for the top 3 levers with clear success metrics.

steps.description: Run the growth experiments and collect results.

inputs.name: experiment-plan
inputs.desc: The experiment design for each tactic

outputs.name: experiment-results
outputs.desc: Results of each growth experiment (metrics versus baseline)

outputs.name: winning-tactics
outputs.desc: Which tactics produced meaningful growth above baseline

process: Execute each experiment for the planned duration.
Track the growth metrics daily or weekly during the experiment.
Compare results against the baseline to determine statistical significance.
Identify the winning tactics and the magnitude of their impact.

steps.description: Scale the winning growth tactics into an ongoing program.

outputs.name: growth-program
outputs.desc: The ongoing growth program with tactics, cadence, and targets

outputs.name: audience-growth-report
outputs.desc: Report on audience growth with projections

process: For each winning tactic, define the ongoing execution cadence and resources needed.
Set growth targets for the next quarter based on experiment results.
Build the growth activities into the regular content operations workflow.
Set up a monthly review cadence to track progress and adjust.

description: Launch and manage a paid membership or community for a creator or brand.

steps.description: Define the membership tiers, pricing, and benefits.

inputs.name: creator-audience-data
inputs.desc: Audience size, engagement, and willingness-to-pay signals

inputs.name: content-assets
inputs.desc: What exclusive content or access the creator can offer

outputs.name: tier-structure
outputs.desc: The membership tiers with pricing and benefits for each

outputs.name: platform-selection
outputs.desc: The chosen membership platform (Patreon, Discord, Substack, custom)

process: Research what membership tiers and pricing work for similar creators in the niche.
Design 2 to 3 tiers with escalating benefits (content, access, community, perks).
Set pricing based on the audience's demonstrated willingness to pay.
Select the membership platform based on features, fees, and audience preferences.

steps.description: Create the onboarding experience for new members.

outputs.name: onboarding-sequence
outputs.desc: The welcome flow for new members (emails, messages, orientation)

outputs.name: member-guide
outputs.desc: A guide explaining how to access benefits and participate

process: Write the welcome message that introduces the community and sets expectations.
Design the onboarding sequence (welcome email, orientation tour, first exclusive content).
Create the member guide with instructions for accessing each benefit.
Set up automated delivery so new members receive the onboarding immediately.

steps.description: Plan the exclusive content calendar for members.

outputs.name: member-content-calendar
outputs.desc: Scheduled exclusive content by tier and date

outputs.name: engagement-activities
outputs.desc: Planned community activities (Q&A, live sessions, challenges)

process: Define the exclusive content types for each tier (early access, behind-the-scenes, bonus content, live sessions).
Schedule the content on a regular cadence that members can expect.
Plan community engagement activities (AMAs, challenges, feedback sessions).
Balance the effort required against the free content production schedule.

steps.description: Track membership metrics and manage retention.

outputs.name: membership-metrics
outputs.desc: Active members, MRR, churn rate, engagement by tier

outputs.name: membership-program-plan
outputs.desc: The complete membership program plan with performance data

process: Track the key metrics monthly: new members, churned members, MRR, engagement rate.
Identify the reasons for churn (survey, behavior analysis, cancellation feedback).
Test retention interventions (win-back campaigns, loyalty rewards, content adjustments).
Produce the program report with metrics and planned adjustments.

description: Launch a digital product (course, ebook, template, tool) from validation through sales analysis.

steps.description: Validate the digital product idea with the audience before building.

inputs.name: product-concept
inputs.desc: The product idea (what it is, who it is for, what problem it solves)

inputs.name: audience-data
inputs.desc: The creator's audience size, engagement, and expressed interests

outputs.name: validation-results
outputs.desc: Evidence of demand (survey responses, waitlist signups, pre-orders)

outputs.name: product-spec
outputs.desc: The validated product specification (scope, format, pricing)

process: Test the product concept with the audience (poll, survey, landing page with waitlist).
Analyze the response to gauge demand (signup rate, survey interest level).
Refine the product scope and format based on audience feedback.
Set the price based on the value proposition and audience willingness to pay.

steps.description: Create the digital product.

inputs.name: validation-results
inputs.desc: What the audience told you they want

outputs.name: finished-product
outputs.desc: The completed digital product ready for delivery

outputs.name: product-assets
outputs.desc: Supporting assets (preview, sample, demo)

process: Outline the product structure (modules, chapters, sections, templates).
Create the content for each section.
Design the packaging and format for delivery (PDF, video, platform, download).
Create preview or sample assets for use in marketing.

steps.description: Build the sales page and set up the payment and delivery system.

outputs.name: sales-page
outputs.desc: The live sales page with payment integration

outputs.name: delivery-system
outputs.desc: The automated delivery system (email, platform access, download link)

process: Write the sales page copy (headline, problem, solution, benefits, testimonials, CTA).
Set up the payment processor and pricing (one-time, payment plan, early bird).
Configure the automated delivery (access email, login credentials, download).
Test the full purchase flow from landing to delivery.

steps.description: Run the launch campaign across email, social, and affiliates.

outputs.name: launch-metrics
outputs.desc: Sales, revenue, conversion rate, traffic by source

outputs.name: launch-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the launch with what worked and what to improve

process: Execute the launch sequence (pre-launch tease, launch day push, mid-launch update, final call).
Promote through email list, social media, and affiliate or referral partners.
Monitor sales and conversion rate in real time during the launch window.
Compile the launch results and document lessons for the next product.

description: Run a creator-to-creator collaboration from partner identification through performance measurement.

steps.description: Identify and evaluate potential collaboration partners.

inputs.name: creator-niche
inputs.desc: The creator's topic area, audience, and content style

inputs.name: collab-goals
inputs.desc: What the collaboration should achieve (audience growth, content variety, cross-promotion)

outputs.name: partner-shortlist
outputs.desc: Ranked list of potential collaborators with fit scores

outputs.name: overlap-analysis
outputs.desc: Audience overlap and complementarity analysis for each candidate

process: Source potential partners from the same or adjacent niches.
Analyze audience overlap (too much overlap means less growth potential, too little means poor fit).
Evaluate content style compatibility and brand alignment.
Rank candidates by expected collaboration value.

steps.description: Pitch the collaboration concept and agree on the format and timeline.

inputs.name: partner-shortlist
inputs.desc: The ranked list of potential partners

outputs.name: collab-agreement
outputs.desc: The agreed collaboration format, timeline, and responsibilities

outputs.name: content-brief
outputs.desc: The creative brief for the collaborative content

process: Reach out to the top candidates with a specific collaboration concept.
Propose the format (guest appearance, joint video, challenge, swap, co-creation).
Agree on the timeline, responsibilities, and promotion commitments.
Draft the creative brief so both parties are aligned on the content.

steps.description: Produce the collaborative content.

outputs.name: collab-content
outputs.desc: The finished collaborative content for both creators

outputs.name: promo-assets
outputs.desc: Cross-promotion assets for both creators to share

process: Coordinate the production schedule between both creators.
Produce the content according to the brief.
Create cross-promotion assets (clips, teasers, quotes) for both audiences.
Review and approve the final content with the partner.

steps.description: Publish, cross-promote, and measure the collaboration results.

outputs.name: collab-metrics
outputs.desc: Performance metrics (new followers, views, engagement from partner audience)

outputs.name: collaboration-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the collaboration with results and relationship notes

process: Coordinate the publish timing so both creators go live in sync.
Cross-promote on all platforms using the prepared assets.
Track the metrics: new followers from partner audience, views, engagement, subscriber overlap change.
Document the results and relationship notes for future collaborations.

description: Build a content repurposing system that turns pillar content into derivatives across platforms.

steps.description: Identify the pillar content with the highest repurposing potential.

inputs.name: content-library
inputs.desc: The creator's existing content catalog (videos, podcasts, blog posts, presentations)

inputs.name: performance-data
inputs.desc: View counts, engagement, and evergreen scores for each piece

outputs.name: pillar-content-list
outputs.desc: Ranked list of content pieces with the highest repurposing potential

outputs.name: repurpose-opportunity-map
outputs.desc: Which derivative formats each pillar piece can generate

process: Review the content library for pieces that are evergreen, high-performing, or information-dense.
Score each piece on repurposing potential (length, density, visual appeal, topic breadth).
Map each pillar piece to the derivative formats it could produce.
Rank by expected reach and effort ratio.

steps.description: Define the derivative formats and production workflow for each.

inputs.name: repurpose-opportunity-map
inputs.desc: Which derivatives each piece can produce

outputs.name: derivative-specs
outputs.desc: Format specs for each derivative type (clips, quotes, carousels, threads, audiograms)

outputs.name: production-workflow
outputs.desc: Step-by-step workflow for producing each derivative type

process: For each derivative format, define the specs (duration, dimensions, text limits).
Document the production steps for each format (extract, edit, caption, design).
Identify which steps can be templated or automated.
Estimate the time per derivative by format.

steps.description: Produce the derivative content in batches from the pillar content.

inputs.name: derivative-specs
inputs.desc: The specs for each derivative format

inputs.name: production-workflow
inputs.desc: The production steps for each format

outputs.name: derivative-content-batch
outputs.desc: The produced derivative content files ready for scheduling

outputs.name: batch-manifest
outputs.desc: Inventory of all derivatives with their target platforms and publish dates

process: Extract the source segments from the pillar content for each derivative.
Produce each derivative following the format workflow.
Write the captions and metadata for each derivative.
Organize the batch with platform assignments and scheduled dates.

steps.description: Track derivative performance and refine the repurposing system.

inputs.name: batch-manifest
inputs.desc: What was posted where and when

outputs.name: derivative-performance
outputs.desc: Metrics for each derivative versus its source pillar content

outputs.name: repurposing-system-doc
outputs.desc: The documented repurposing system with performance data and improvements

process: Pull analytics for each derivative after the reporting window.
Compare derivative performance to the original pillar content.
Identify which formats and platforms produce the best returns.
Update the repurposing system document with findings and adjustments.
